name: HubSpot
notes: OAuth apps + private-app access tokens; free CRM + free dev account; remote MCP at mcp.hubspot.com (OAuth)

name: Podio
notes: API key = OAuth client id/secret from settings; Free plan (5 users) includes API at 1000 calls/hour

name: Gorgias
notes: Private app = API key over Basic; public app = OAuth2 mandatory; no free plan - trial or approved developer sandbox; vendor MCP in open beta

name: Gladly
notes: Token-based Basic auth (user email + API token); tokens only inside a customer's Gladly org; no self-serve signup

name: Twilio
notes: Account SID + auth token or API key/secret over Basic; free trial account with credit (not time-limited) - borderline free vs trial

name: Lark (Larksuite)
notes: app_id/app_secret -> tenant_access_token; user_access_token via OAuth; official lark-openapi-mcp repo

name: Threads (Meta)
notes: Meta app + OAuth; works for app testers in dev mode; public use needs Meta App Review

name: SendGrid
notes: API key sent as Bearer; free plan replaced by 60-day timed trial (Mar 2025); no official MCP (Twilio blog shows how to build one)

name: Ecwid
notes: "Only stores on paid plans can access API"; developers can request a free test store

name: Amazon Selling Partner
notes: Login with Amazon OAuth; developer profile must be approved (+ Seller Central account); Amazon published sp-api-dev-mcp

name: Sherlock
notes: Python CLI you run locally; no hosted API or credentials

name: Clay
notes: "The developer platform is available across all Clay plans, including free and trial plans"; official Clay MCP

name: GitHub
notes: OAuth apps / PATs / GitHub App JWT; official github-mcp-server

name: Cloudflare
notes: API tokens (Bearer) + legacy global API key; free plan; official MCP servers

name: Airtable
notes: Personal access tokens + OAuth; free plan; official Airtable MCP server

name: Harvest
notes: Personal access token or OAuth2; Free plan (1 seat / 2 projects) still exists

name: Plaid
notes: client_id + secret in request body; free Sandbox; production needs approval; official Plaid MCP

name: iPayX
notes: Defeated a careful human check too: site documents no public REST API or pricing; only an MCP connector listing mentions a dashboard Bearer token. Auth/access/API left unscored.

name: Otter AI
notes: Official Otter MCP (OAuth); "We currently do not have a public API key at this time"

name: Mermaid CLI
notes: Local Node CLI; no auth; Mermaid Chart (the company) runs an MCP but it is not the CLI - MCP label ambiguous
